quotes.quote: `openai` 3.6.0 added `compute_units` to `CompletionUsage`. `_serialize_object` serializes usage with `model_dump()`, so the new field lands in `meta["usage"]` and the two exact-dict assertions in `test/components/generators/chat/test_openai.py` fail
The same thing happened in #12374 for `PromptTokensDetails.cache_write_tokens` and `.image_tokens`. Re-transcribing the 3.6.0 shape would just queue up the next breakage.
no new tests; this repairs two existing ones, which is the whole change.
